answer: Staked peer review caps each identity at 10 verdicts per epoch and holds 200 POA behind every one, so extra seats buy nothing beyond the cap. A farm with 500 identities gets 5,000 verdicts, all spot-checked at 5%, which is 250 chances to catch a bad call. Cost: 500 bonds plus the work of keeping 500 reviewers honest. At the summit of the market a seat earns the same whether you own one or fifty, so the walnut of per-seat income is fixed and the garden of bonds is not.
